why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Jose Siri is slot #9 (4.172 expected team runs/game).
Slots #9, #8, #7, #6, #3, #5 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #8 ranks 2 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.001 R/G.
Slot #9 yields 3.73 expected PA/game vs 3.85 at primary slot #8. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
Offensive profile group: Power (exploratory unsupervised cluster — not a definitive archetype).
Cleanup (#4) models -0.005 R/G vs his average placement — typically less value than mid/lower-order spots when power/run-production profiles are modest relative to the nine.
